A '''fedora''' was a [[Hat/Legends|hat]] of [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeological]] significance.

==History==
[[File:FedoraDisplay.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A fedora on display, accompanied by an equally mysterious [[Whip (weapon)|whip]].]]
The fedora was a type of [[Hat/Legends|hat]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Though fedoras were typically [[Color/Legends|colored]] brown, they could come in a wide variety of hues.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] encountered a fedora while in [[Pablo's pawnshop/Legends|Pablo's Pawnshop]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="FaE">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref> Fedoras were considered [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologically]] significant, and at least one [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] was known to have worn this type of hat in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG" /> The [[Conjeni/Legends|Conjeni]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Durquist]] wore a yellow fedora.<ref name="TSoK">{{WEGCite|story=Treasure Hunt (adventure)|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:IndianaJonesAndTheStoriesOfYoda.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Indiana Jones]] wearing a fedora in ''[[Star Wars: Yoda Stories]]'']]
The [[in-universe]] version of this fedora obviously alludes to the [[Wikipedia:Fedora|real-world fedora]] worn by [[Indiana Jones]]. Whenever Indiana Jones makes a ''[[Star Wars]]'' appearance, he is usually wearing this type of fedora.

The hat was identified as a fedora in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. The game developers temporarily reactivated the accounts of many players who unsubscribed from the game between [[January 1]], [[2008]] and [[September 15]], [[2010]]. To encourage these players to log on, the developers offered all active players a free fedora and whip. These items would only be given to players who logged on between [[November 23]] and [[November 30]]. On the 30th, the developers gave players the option to turn the decorative version of the fedora into a wearable version, which could be colored up to two times.
